pieces.title: Harvest of the Grinning Dark
pieces.description: A giant glowing jack-o'-lantern with a menacing carved grin looms over smaller grinning pumpkins in a murky field of tangled, thorny vines at night.

pieces.title: Staircase Within the Iris
pieces.description: A macro close-up of a dark human eye whose iris contains a candlelit spiral staircase and a lone cloaked figure facing a swirling tunnel.

pieces.title: Neon Mushroom Pond Reverie
pieces.description: A pointy-eared fairy girl in a glowing mushroom cap hat eats an ice cream cone in a neon pond with glowing jars, lily pads, and giant eyes above.

pieces.title: Ember Queen of Ash
pieces.description: A red-haired woman in black armor veined with glowing lava stands amid swirling flames, holding a ball of fire in her outstretched hand.

pieces.title: Guardian of the Midnight Cosmos
pieces.description: A stern bearded warrior with dark curly hair wears ornate black and gold armor beside a black panther, beneath a starry sky with a golden all-seeing eye.

pieces.title: Tea Hour in the Glowing Grove
pieces.description: A gray alien in an ornate purple top hat and jeweled robe sips steaming tea from a porcelain cup among glowing mushrooms and floating ghostly spirits.

pieces.title: Stormborn Silver Sentinel
pieces.description: A silver-haired woman with glowing blue eyes, wearing ornate silver armor, floats among storm clouds as translucent, shimmering ribbons swirl around her.

pieces.title: Headlines Under the Skin
pieces.description: A pink-haired person in a black leather trench coat strides along a subway platform, their face and neck covered in newspaper-print patterns, as a train blurs past.

pieces.title: Golden Hour on the Fence
pieces.description: A smiling woman with wavy blonde hair sits on a wooden fence in a wildflower meadow at sunset, holding a bottle, with a red barn and hen behind.

pieces.title: Golden Hour Serenade
pieces.description: A tattooed woman in a cream lace dress and cowboy boots plays an acoustic guitar on a patterned blanket in a wildflower meadow at sunset.

pieces.title: Aurora Smoke on the Pier
pieces.description: An elderly woman in a floral dress sits on a wooden lakeside dock at night, smoking, beneath green and purple auroras, with mushrooms growing beside her.

pieces.title: Smoke Among the Glowing Mushrooms
pieces.description: A silver-haired figure in a flower crown and dark shawl smokes a cigarette in a nighttime forest lit by glowing blue-violet mushrooms and fireflies.
